artifact_role: PI-ratified machine-readable companion of the canonical interaction; the independent source-fidelity anchor for Phase-A reconstruction

vocabulary.bilinear(M_int, M_dirac): psibar_{a,alpha} (M_int)_{ab} (M_dirac)_{alpha beta} psi_{b,beta}, all indices contracted
vocabulary.lam(A): U(N) generator, A = 0..N**2-1, normalization trace(lam(A)*lam(B)) = 2*KroneckerDelta(A,B), lam(0) = sqrt(2/N)*IdN

canonical_interaction_expression: (G/(2*N)) * Sum( bilinear(lam(A), Id4)**2 + bilinear(lam(A), I*gamma5)**2, (A, 0, N**2-1) )
scope_note: This expression is the four-fermion interaction term of §2 (the object the Phase-A decomposition must reconstruct); the free kinetic term Sum(bilinear(IdN, I*gamma(mu)*d(mu)), ...) is part of the canonical action but not of the interaction decomposition.

ratification.review_required: Discriminator (ChatGPT) must verify this transcription against §2 of the ratified markdown (v0.5 text) before the PI ratifies; the PI's delivery of the Phase-A prompt carrying this artifact's sha256 pin constitutes ratification
ratification.amendment_rule: any change to this artifact is a full-chain amendment, versioned alongside the markdown
